svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Released Pro: a complete floating-point draft block schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Released Pro: a complete floating-point draft block
svg.desc: This is the pinned V4-Pro inference reference, not a substitution of Pro dimensions into the V4.1 Flash model. Draft depth runs vertically; proposed token positions run horizontally. Temporary draft KV never becomes retained target history. Mathematical details and the Flash mapping follow below.

g.aria-label: Read selected target block outputs — layers 59, 60, 61 · mean over 4 streams
g.title: Read selected target block outputs — inspect equation and evidence
